When does New Year 2027 start in Mexico?

Mexico spans 4 different UTC offsets on New Year's Eve, so 2027 arrives in waves. The first region to celebrate is Cancún (UTC-05:00) at 05:00 UTC on Friday, January 1, 2027, and the last is Tijuana (UTC-08:00), 3 hours later.

The countdown above follows Mexico City, where midnight falls at 06:00 UTC.

Mexico in the global New Year countdown

The first places on Earth to enter 2027 are the Line Islands of Kiribati (UTC+14:00). Mexico City follows 20 hours later, and the last inhabited places, American Samoa and Niue (UTC-11:00), celebrate 5 hours after Mexico City.

When the clock strikes midnight in Mexico City, 189 of the 196 countries in our world time zone table already have at least one region celebrating 2027.

  • Just before (UTC-05:00): Brazil (Rio Branco), Canada (Toronto), Chile (Easter Island), Colombia, Cuba, Ecuador (Quito), Panama, Peru and 4 more
  • Just after (UTC-07:00): Canada (Calgary) and United States (Denver)

Who celebrates at the same time as Mexico?

These countries also reach midnight at UTC-06:00, so they welcome 2027 at exactly the same moment as Mexico City: Canada (Winnipeg), Costa Rica, Ecuador (Galápagos Islands), El Salvador, Guatemala, Honduras, Nicaragua, United States (Chicago) and Belize.

New Year traditions in Mexico

Many Mexicans eat twelve grapes at midnight, one for each chime, making a wish with each one. Others wear red or yellow underwear for love or prosperity, or walk around the block with a suitcase to attract travel in the new year.

Frequently asked questions

What time is New Year 2027 in Mexico in UTC?

Midnight in Mexico City corresponds to 06:00 UTC on Friday, January 1, 2027. Other regions of Mexico follow, up to 3 hours apart.

How many time zones does Mexico have on New Year's Eve?

Mexico uses 4 different UTC offsets on December 31, from UTC-05:00 in Cancún to UTC-08:00 in Tijuana.

Is daylight saving time in effect in Mexico on New Year's Eve?

No. Mexico City keeps UTC-06:00 all year round.

Which countries celebrate New Year just before Mexico?

The previous time zone to reach midnight is UTC-05:00, which includes Brazil (Rio Branco), Canada (Toronto), Chile (Easter Island), Colombia, Cuba, Ecuador (Quito), Panama, Peru and 4 more.
